claim: Apple's net income was at least $20.5 billion in Q1 2023.
summary: Apple's net income in Q1 2023 exceeded $20.5B under either fiscal or calendar definition (approx $30B for fiscal Q1 ended Dec 2022 and approx $24.2B for calendar Q1 ended Apr 2023), so the 'at least $20.5B' claim is supported by prior knowledge.

sub_claims.text: Apple's net income was at least $20.5 billion in Q1 2023.
sub_claims.note: From prior knowledge: Apple fiscal Q1 2023 (quarter ended Dec 31, 2022) net income ~$30.0B; Apple fiscal Q2 2023 corresponding to calendar Q1 2023 (quarter ended Apr 1, 2023) net income ~$24.16B. Both exceed 20.5 in USD billions. No external citations used.
